summary: The GenerateCourse module is a web user control for generating course correspondence within the HSPnet system. It enables users (typically coordinators and administrators) to select departments, programs, terms, cohorts, courses, and apply filters to generate recipient lists and correspondence documents in various formats. The control manages workflows for both outbox-driven and course-driven correspondence, encapsulating business rules, validations, and dynamic field assembly for correspondence generation.
purpose: To facilitate the generation of customized course correspondence documents for selected recipients, including options for document format, inclusion of logos, address information, CCs, and date settings, ensuring that users can flexibly configure and generate recipient lists and correspondence output based on their permissions and contextual requirements.

workflows.name: Generate Correspondence
steps: Page_Load: Set up context based on QueryString (CohortID, CourseID), adjust UI visibility.
DataBind: Fill dropdowns for department, program, term, choosers, and date source.
SetupJavaScript: Register dynamic variables and UI controls for client-side interaction.
User sets filters/status via cklStatus, selects department/program/term, and optionally a cohort/course.
User chooses output format and options (PDF, MultiPDF, RTF, XLS, TXT, LABEL).
User sets correspondence options: addressee, logo inclusion, department address, CCs, signatory, date, etc.
Validation: Check recipient list is not empty, validate date, ensure required fields are set.
cmdGerenate_Click: On generate button click, creates run variables, selects recipients, builds correspondence output based on selected parameters.
If successful, opens CorrespondenceRecipientsPopup with generated correspondence for review/download.
Handles workflow for both Outbox (bulk/agency-driven) and Course context (single course/cohort).

business_rules: Outbox correspondence requires valid recipient list (txtRequestDestID must not be '-1' or empty).
Status filters must be selected from cklStatus.
Correspondence date must be valid and parsed correctly (using DateFormatter.ParseDate).
Output format must be selected through radio buttons; only one format allowed.
If both CohortID and CourseID are present in QueryString, user cannot change cohort/course selection and correspondence is scheduled.
Correspondence for Courses requires correct ProgramID and Term selection.
FormalLetter option affects signature selection logic.
validations: Recipient list validation: not empty, not '-1'.
Date validation: txtCorDate must be valid or trigger error.
Dropdowns for department, program, term must be correctly populated.
Status filter validation: at least one must be selected if applicable.
Checkboxes/radio button validation for correspondence options (e.g., logo, CCs, address).
calculations: Date reset calculations for Outbox using CustomDateFrom and CustomDateTo.
Correspondence date formatting depends on language settings (French/English).
Schedule calculations for correspondence based on PR DueDate for scheduled correspondence.
conditions: If Outbox is true, UI and data logic adjusts to agency-driven correspondence.
If QueryString contains CohortID and CourseID, fixed selection for course/cohort, disables chooser.
FormalLetter alters available options and signature selection.
Department/program/term dropdowns enabled/disabled based on QueryString and page state.
If chkUseBlankAddressee is checked, suppress order fields for correspondence addressee.
system_behavior: Dynamic UI adjustments based on role, context (Outbox/Course), and permissions.
Dropdown population for department, program, term, date source based on UserSession and QueryString.
Javascript variables registered for client-side interactivity.
Run variables are saved for correspondence generation, mapped to selected options and controls.
CorrespondenceRecipientsPopup builds dynamic correspondence preview/download based on selections.
Validations trigger errors and messaging for missing/invalid data.
dependencies: UserSession context governs access, visibility, and workflow.
Departments, Programs, Terms, Courses, Cohorts are populated and filtered based on UserSession and permissions.
CorrespondenceDetails and CorrespondenceRunVariables are required for assembling correspondence.
Dropdowns and choosers depend on QueryString for default values and enable/disable logic.
exceptions: If no recipients are selected or recipient list is invalid, error is shown and correspondence is not generated.
If correspondence date is invalid, error messaging and halt workflow.
If required permissions or context are missing (UserSession), dropdowns and selection logic are disabled or canceled.
